$comment: Verdicts GitHub Actions owes dotclaude for the window it refused every job (GarrettMakesItLLC/platform#998). A `paid` records the run, the main SHA and the result. Keep `.claude/fleet-mode.json` on `degraded` until every item is paid.

items.verdict: One validate.yml run of main on Actions, including the shellcheck install and the CI Success aggregate as the runner executes them.
items.why: The replica runs validate's steps on a dev box with a local shellcheck (the apt install line is dropped) and treats the `CI Success` aggregate as the replica table itself.
items.howToPay: Actions → validate → Run workflow on main, or the first PR after the window. Record the run URL, SHA and conclusion.

paid.note: validate on push to main: JSON, shellcheck (apt-installed), self-tests and bin/ tool self-tests all success. CI Success runs only on pull_request, so the aggregate is evidenced by the PR run https://github.com/GarrettMakesItLLC/dotclaude/actions/runs/36663770193 (head 95c52e8ab3dbb413066fe1d92395928d264d91a3): all five jobs, CI Success included, succeeded.

items.verdict: One validate.yml run of main on Actions after #498 merged in degraded mode, including the shellcheck install and the CI Success aggregate as the runner executes them.
items.why: #498 merged on a local ci-replica verdict while Actions refused every job (startup_failure); the replica reports ci-success NOT-RUN.
items.howToPay: Actions → validate → Run workflow on main once Actions runs again, or the first PR after the window. Record the run URL, SHA and conclusion.
